title: Schedule Free Consultation
subtitle: Get in touch via scheduled call or email
description: During our consultation, we'll discuss what brings you to therapy, learn more about my approach, and answer any questions you have. Choose a time below that works for you, or feel free to email me directly at [admin@marupsychotherapy.com](mailto:admin@marupsychotherapy.com)
disclaimerText: If you require immediate psychiatric assistance, please call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room and request a mental health consult. You can also contact the Georgia Crisis and Access Line at 1-800-815-4225, the Crisis Text Line by texting "HOME" to 741741, or dial 988 to reach the National Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.
